President Aoun @LBpresidency and PM Salam @nawafsalam will convene the Lebanese cabinet for an emergency meeting in 3 hours. They should take the following decisions or resign:

1. Announce the disbanding of the Hezbollah militia and restrict its existence to a political party, including making illegal its chain of command, intelligence apparatus, and arms. Under Lebanese law, names and addresses of party officials must be provided to the Interior Ministry.

2. Locate and arrest Hezbollah members who fired missiles at Israel and bring them, along with those who gave the orders, to justice.

3. Accelerate the disarmament of the now-illegal militia.
